001package com.streamConverter.command.impl.xml;
002
003import com.streamConverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
004import com.streamConverter.path.TreePath;
005import java.io.IOException;
006import java.io.InputStream;
007import java.io.OutputStream;
008import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
009import java.io.StringWriter;
010import java.io.Writer;
011import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
012import java.util.ArrayList;
013import java.util.List;
014import java.util.logging.Logger;
015import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventReader;
016import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventWriter;
017import javax.xml.stream.XMLInputFactory;
018import javax.xml.stream.XMLOutputFactory;
019import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException;
020import javax.xml.stream.events.XMLEvent;
021
022/**
023 * XML Filter Command Class
024 *
025 * <p>This class implements pure data extraction from XML using TreePath expressions. Unlike
026 * XmlNavigateCommand which applies transformations, XmlFilterCommand only extracts/filters elements
027 * based on specified paths without any modifications.
028 *
029 * <p>Features: - Extract specific elements using TreePath expressions - Preserve exact XML
030 * structure of extracted elements - Memory-efficient streaming processing - Support for complex
031 * path expressions including nested elements and attributes
032 */
033public class XmlFilterCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
034  private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(XmlFilterCommand.class.getName());
035
036  private final TreePath xpath;
037
038  /**
039   * Constructor for XML filtering with TreePath selector.
040   *
041   * @param xpath the TreePath expression to extract elements (e.g., "users/user/name")
042   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if xpath is null or empty
043   * @deprecated Use {@link #XmlFilterCommand(TreePath)} instead
044   */
045  @Deprecated
046  public XmlFilterCommand(String xpath) {
047    if (xpath == null || xpath.trim().isEmpty()) {
048      throw new IllegalArgumentException("TreePath cannot be null or empty");
049    }
050    xpath.trim();
051    this.xpath = TreePath.fromXml(xpath.trim());
052  }
053
054  /**
055   * Constructor for XML filtering with typed TreePath selector.
056   *
057   * @param xpath the typed TreePath to extract elements
058   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if xpath is null
059   */
060  public XmlFilterCommand(TreePath xpath) {
061    if (xpath == null) {
062      throw new IllegalArgumentException("TreePath cannot be null");
063    }
064    this.xpath = xpath;
065    xpath.toString();
066  }
067
068  @Override
069  protected String getCommandDetails() {
070    return String.format("XmlFilterCommand(xpath='%s')", xpath.toString());
071  }
072
073  @Override
074  protected void executeInternal(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
075      throws IOException {
076    try (Writer writer = new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
077
078      XMLInputFactory inputFactory = XMLInputFactory.newInstance();
079      inputFactory.setProperty(XMLInputFactory.IS_SUPPORTING_EXTERNAL_ENTITIES, false);
080      inputFactory.setProperty(XMLInputFactory.SUPPORT_DTD, false);
081
082      List<String> extractedElements = new ArrayList<>();
083
084      XMLEventReader reader = inputFactory.createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
085      List<String> currentPath = new ArrayList<>();
086      boolean isCapturing = false;
087      int captureDepth = 0;
088      int currentDepth = 0;
089
090      XMLOutputFactory outputFactory = XMLOutputFactory.newInstance();
091      StringWriter elementWriter = new StringWriter();
092
093      while (reader.hasNext()) {
094        XMLEvent event = reader.nextEvent();
095
096        if (event.isStartElement()) {
097          currentDepth++;
098          String elementName = event.asStartElement().getName().getLocalPart();
099          currentPath.add(elementName);
100
101          // Check if this element matches our target path
102          if (xpath.match(currentPath) && !isCapturing) {
103            isCapturing = true;
104            captureDepth = currentDepth;
105            elementWriter = new StringWriter();
106
107            try {
108              XMLEventWriter eventWriter = outputFactory.createXMLEventWriter(elementWriter);
109              eventWriter.add(event);
110              eventWriter.close();
111            } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
112              LOGGER.warning("Error writing start element: " + e.getMessage());
113            }
114          } else if (isCapturing && currentDepth > captureDepth) {
115            // We're inside a matching element, continue capturing
116            try {
117              XMLEventWriter eventWriter = outputFactory.createXMLEventWriter(elementWriter);
118              eventWriter.add(event);
119              eventWriter.close();
120            } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
121              LOGGER.warning("Error writing nested start element: " + e.getMessage());
122            }
123          }
124
125        } else if (event.isEndElement()) {
126          if (isCapturing) {
127            try {
128              XMLEventWriter eventWriter = outputFactory.createXMLEventWriter(elementWriter);
129              eventWriter.add(event);
130              eventWriter.close();
131            } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
132              LOGGER.warning("Error writing end element: " + e.getMessage());
133            }
134
135            // If we're closing the captured element
136            if (currentDepth == captureDepth) {
137              extractedElements.add(elementWriter.toString());
138              isCapturing = false;
139              captureDepth = 0;
140            }
141          }
142
143          currentPath.remove(currentPath.size() - 1);
144          currentDepth--;
145
146        } else if (isCapturing) {
147          // Characters, comments, etc. inside captured element
148          try {
149            XMLEventWriter eventWriter = outputFactory.createXMLEventWriter(elementWriter);
150            eventWriter.add(event);
151            eventWriter.close();
152          } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
153            LOGGER.warning("Error writing content: " + e.getMessage());
154          }
155        }
156      }
157
158      // Write extracted elements to output
159      writeExtractedElements(writer, extractedElements);
160
161      reader.close();
162    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
163      throw new IOException("Error processing XML: " + e.getMessage(), e);
164    }
165  }
166
167  /**
168   * Write extracted XML elements to the output writer
169   *
170   * @param writer the output writer
171   * @param elements list of extracted XML elements
172   * @throws IOException if writing fails
173   */
174  private void writeExtractedElements(Writer writer, List<String> elements) throws IOException {
175    if (elements.isEmpty()) {
176      // No matching elements found - output empty XML fragment
177      writer.write("");
178      writer.flush();
179      return;
180    }
181
182    if (elements.size() == 1) {
183      // Single element - write directly
184      writer.write(elements.get(0));
185    } else {
186      // Multiple elements - wrap in a root element
187      writer.write("<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>");
188      writer.write("<filtered-results>");
189      for (String element : elements) {
190        writer.write(element);
191      }
192      writer.write("</filtered-results>");
193    }
194
195    writer.flush();
196  }
197}
